reviews.review_text: I agree with the first review. I would have liked to have a choice of chain lengths. The pendant design is perfect for my outfits. Most pearl pendants are in dainty settings. This is my second purchase from this site. . Usually I have to take online purchases to the jewler to have the pearl replaced for better quality. Not this time.
